ORAL ORDER 3 12-09-2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned APP for the State.
2. This is an application for quashing of the F.I.R. of Manihari P.S. Case No. 56 of 2022 registered under Sections 149, 420, 379, 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. After some argument, learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw this application.
5. Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.
